sources.title: SISU International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship 2026 guide: March2027 semester
CLEC International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship: official application entry
sources.publisher: Center for Language Education and Cooperation

name.en: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at SISU — March2027 semester
name.zh: 上海外国语大学国际中文教师奖学金（2027年3月一学期研修）

summary.en: March2027 one-semester, non-degree scholarship, funded for five months. SISU waives tuition and reduces accommodation charges; the accommodation reduction amount and a free-dorm guarantee are not published in this notice. Living allowance is CNY2500 per month, and university-purchased comprehensive medical insurance is CNY400 per person/semester. Student applications for March2027 must finish by 31 October2026. The notice’s procedure paragraph still describes the March1–May15 window; it does not separately announce the spring opening date, so confirm the active spring application channel with SISU. Complete both the CLEC scholarship system and SISU’s specific ICLT application channel; upload the central-system application form, submit the SISU study application and pay its application fee. The fee amount is not specified here and payment is non-refundable regardless of admission. The verified HTTPS CLEC entry has an Apply action; SISU’s notice names apply.shisu.edu.cn without establishing a fresh HTTPS endpoint. Recommending-institution nomination is mandatory. No travel/visa or other unlisted-cost reimbursement is promised; award selection and cancellation rules apply.
summary.zh: 2027年3月入学、资助五个月的一学期非学历研修奖学金。上外免学费并减免住宿费，但本通知未公布住宿减免金额或免费宿舍保证；生活费每月人民币2500元，学校统一购买的综合医疗保险每人每学期400元。春季学生申请须于2026年10月31日前完成。流程段仍描述3月1日至5月15日的窗口，未单独公布春季开放日，须向上外确认当前春季申请通道。必须完成中央奖学金系统及上外国际中文教师奖学金专项通道，上传中央系统申请表、提交上外学习项目申请并支付申请费；本通知未注明费用金额，且无论录取与否支付后均不退。本条链接为有“我要申请”按钮的语合中心HTTPS入口；上外通知仅写apply.shisu.edu.cn，未据此编造已核验HTTPS校级入口。须联系推荐机构网上推荐；未承诺交通、签证或其他未明列费用报销，择优及取消规则适用。

eligibility.en: For prospective international applicants entering the March2027 semester; this is an admission scholarship rather than an enrolled-only merit award, and admission does not guarantee funding.
eligibility.zh: 面向申请2027年3月一学期项目的新申请者，为来华入学奖学金，非仅限在读生评优；录取不保证获资助。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen; friendly to China, no criminal record, obey Chinese laws and host rules, good physical/mental health and academic/behavioral standing, interested in Chinese language education and related work. Age16–35 on 1 September2026, extended to45 for in-service Chinese teachers.
eligibility.zh: 非中国籍，对华友好、无犯罪记录，遵守中国法律及校规，身心健康、品学兼优，有志于中文教育及相关工作；以2026年9月1日计年龄16–35岁，在职中文教师可放宽至45岁。

eligibility.en: For International Chinese Language Education, Chinese Language and Literature, Chinese History or Chinese Philosophy, HSK Level3 at least180 plus an HSKK report is required. For Traditional Chinese Medicine or Taiji Culture, an HSK report is required and HSKK is preferred; this alternative is not assigned the other directions’ HSK3 threshold. Test reports are valid for two years.
eligibility.zh: 国际中文教育、汉语言文学、中国历史、中国哲学方向要求HSK三级至少180分并具有HSKK成绩；中医和太极文化方向要求HSK成绩，提供HSKK者优先，不将其他方向的HSK三级门槛套用于此分支。成绩报告有效期两年。

eligibility.en: In principle no repeat one-semester/one-year award if the same type was received in the previous three years. Contact a recognized recommending institution and obtain online nomination. In-service teachers attach employment proof and an employer recommendation; Chinese Bridge scholarship-certificate holders follow the certificate procedure.
eligibility.zh: 原则上不录取近三年内享受过同类一学期或一学年奖学金的申请者；联系合格推荐机构办理网上推荐。在职中文教师附任职证明及单位推荐信；汉语桥奖学金证书持有人按证书流程办理。

eligibility.en: All semester applicants submit passport photo-page scan, HSK/HSKK report scans and the recommending institution head’s recommendation. Under18 applicants provide designation documents signed by an entrusted guardian in China; additional university documents may be required. Degree-specific CSCA, diplomas, specialist recommendations and research statements are not silently imposed on the non-degree semester route.
eligibility.zh: 一学期申请者提交护照照片页、HSK/HSKK成绩扫描件及推荐机构负责人推荐信；未满18岁另交在华监护人署名的委托证明，学校可要求其他补充材料。不将学历类别专属的CSCA、学历、专家推荐信及研究陈述套用于非学历一学期类别。

eligibility.en: Only after a study-programme application is successfully submitted through SISU’s ICLT channel will its scholarship-system application be accepted. Failed pre-enrollment medical examination, withdrawal, unauthorized late/non-registration or suspension cancels eligibility.
eligibility.zh: 只有在上外国际中文教师奖学金专项通道成功提交学习项目申请后，中央奖学金系统申请才会被受理；体检不合格、中途退学、未经许可不按时报到或休学等将取消资格。
